# The Seascape, Alibag

> The Seascape (also listed as The Seascape Beach Villa and Resort) is a sea-view resort at Korlai on the Revdanda–Murud road, south of Alibag, Maharashtra, India. It offers six room categories including two private pool suites, an outdoor common pool, and an in-house restaurant serving authentic Konkani and multi-cuisine food. Rooms from ₹6,500 per night.

## Key facts

- Address: Revdanda–Murud Rd, Korlai, Maharashtra 402202, India
- Coordinates: 18.5323779, 72.9257567
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 72767 00667 (bookings are made directly by WhatsApp or phone)
- Check-in from 2:00 PM; check-out by 11:00 AM
- Website: https://seascapealibag.com/
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/theseascapealibag
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=3692919729882652587

## Rooms

- [Open to Sky Private Pool](https://seascapealibag.com/rooms/open-to-sky-private-pool-suite): king bed, Bali-style bathroom, private open-to-sky plunge pool
- [Close to Sky Private Pool](https://seascapealibag.com/rooms/close-to-sky-private-pool-suite): living room, study area, sheltered private pool
- [Bath-Tub Room with Sea View](https://seascapealibag.com/rooms/bath-tub-room-sea-view): king bed, sea-facing soaking tub
- [Family Room with Sea View](https://seascapealibag.com/rooms/family-room-sea-view): two double beds, next to the common pool
- [Couple Room with Pool View](https://seascapealibag.com/rooms/couple-room-pool-view): open patio onto the common pool
- [Couple Beach View Room](https://seascapealibag.com/rooms/couple-beach-view-room): direct beach views, sea-view balcony
